Pinned marmelroy/Zip 2.1.2, commit 67fa55813b9e7b3b9acee9c0ae501def28746d76. Root-owned destination validation replaces unsafe direct archive path concatenation before any filesystem writes. Absolute/parent/NUL paths and symlink escapes are rejected. Encryption and compression APIs are retained. This is a source patch for CVE-2023-39135, not an upstream fixed release. Original MIT/minizip license notices are retained.
